name: datetime-input

frames.best_why: Frame 5 shows a parsed date in the field with the confirmation line; earlier frames only show the placeholder.

tagline: Type a date in plain English; it fills in the exact date and time.
summary: A single-line field that turns phrases like "tomorrow at 5pm" into a real date and time, with a calendar button for picking by hand. Options hide the calendar, the time list, or show both.
appearance: A slim dark rounded rectangle with a thin grey border, a small square calendar icon button on the left and a long text input filling the rest. Placeholder text is small and grey; a short helper line sits underneath.
behaviour: Typing a phrase such as "tomorrow at 5pm" and pressing Enter or leaving the field rewrites it as a formatted date and fills the line below. The border brightens while the field has focus. The calendar button opens a date and time popover.
demo_content: "Schedule post" label, placeholder with sample phrases, and a Publishes timestamp line
search_phrases: type a date in plain english
date and time picker with popover
pick a day and hour in one field
use_when: Users should pick a date and time but you also want typing "tomorrow 5pm" to work.
avoid_when: Pulls in a natural-language date parser; vague phrases can resolve to the wrong day.
customise: placeholder, disabled, showCalendar and showTimePicker are props; colours and layout need a source edit.
weight_why: One input, a popover panel and a date library; idle when closed.

a11y.note: Calendar button has a hidden 'calendar' label but the input relies on its placeholder; focus outline is stripped.

issues: No frame shows the calendar or time popover open, so the main picker UI is unseen.
The field's own outline is stripped; only the container border hints at focus.
polish_why: Tidy standard field styling, but the frames never reveal the popover it is built around.
title: Datetime Input
